title: A perfect treat while visiting Seville!
text: A fun and delicious experience! The ice cream was excellent, with a great variety of flavors, and the guide made the tasting even more enjoyable by sharing interesting facts about the local ingredients and traditions.
author: paucxmbil

title: Fantastic
text: Very interesting activity, we learned a lot and the ice cream flavors were simply delicious and unique ! It is not a “tour” per say as they are partenered with one ice cream shop, and we stay in one place, but it did not alter our experience whatsoever. Would definitely recommend !
author: N3403YQclaral
